source_markets: UK + US, plus other visitors comfortable buying in English
behavioural_frame: First or early Amsterdam visit; 1-4 day stay; culture/discovery oriented
customer_jobs: Understand Amsterdam quickly; connect history to current city life; get orientation and onward recommendations
evidence_for: Strong English VOC; UK city-break fit; US advance-booking behaviour; very high connectivity; highest operating feasibility
evidence_gap: High supply means this is not a language whitespace claim; willingness-to-pay and exact subsegment remain untested
